News global nation business lifestyle entertainment technology sports opinion LATEST NEWS STORIES HEADLINES METRO REGIONS NATION WORLD CDN NEWSLETTER Key Moments Related Stories Key moments Related stories Special Coverage LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 9, 2026 11:02 AM November 09, 2026"> INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 11:02 AM November 09, 2026 Latest updates Latest Oldest MANILA, Philippines —The Senate impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte resumes on Monday, Nov. 9, marking Day 40 of the proceedings, after a nearly monthlong recess. Her defense team is set to present witnesses and evidence to counter allegations of unexplained wealth and undeclared assets, amid calls from the prosecution and the public for Duterte to personally take the witness stand and answer the accusations.
